# DROP DOCUMENTS

Remove the documents of the data file.

## Syntax

```text
DROP DOCUMENTS.
```

The command removes every document line that DOCUMENT or ADD DOCUMENT stored with the data. The change is saved with the next SAVE.

## Example

```text
DROP DOCUMENTS.
```

`statscraft help DROP DOCUMENTS` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
